import numpy as np

# Data in thousands of dollars from the table
years = np.array([1929, 1930, 1931, 1932, 1933, 1934, 1935, 1936, 1937, 1938, 1939, 1940, 1941, 1942])
# Individual income tax receipts (in thousands of dollars)
receipts_thousands = np.array([1095541, 1146845, 833648, 427191, 352573, 419509, 527113, 674416, 1091741, 1286312, 1028834, 982017, 1417655, 3262800])

# Convert to billions (divide by 1,000,000 since values are in thousands)
receipts_billions = receipts_thousands / 1_000_000

print("Years:", years)
print("Receipts (billions):", receipts_billions)

# OLS Regression: receipts = intercept + slope * year
n = len(years)
sum_x = np.sum(years)
sum_y = np.sum(receipts_billions)
sum_xy = np.sum(years * receipts_billions)
sum_x2 = np.sum(years**2)

# Calculate slope and intercept
slope = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_x2 - sum_x**2)
intercept = (sum_y - slope * sum_x) / n

print(f"\nSlope: {slope:.6f}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept:.6f}")
print(f"\nRounded to 3 decimals:")
print(f"Slope: {round(slope, 3)}")
print(f"Intercept: {round(intercept, 3)}")

# Format as required
answer = f"[{round(slope, 3)}, {round(intercept, 3)}]"
print(f"\nAnswer: {answer}")
EOF

receipts_thousands = [1095541, 1146845, 833648, 427191, 352573, 419509, 527113, 674416, 1091741, 1286312, 1028834, 982017, 1417655, 3262800]

# Convert to billions (divide by 1,000,000 since values are in thousands)
receipts_billions = [r / 1_000_000 for r in receipts_thousands]

print("Data points:")
for y, r in zip(years, receipts_billions):
    print(f"  {y}: {r:.6f} billion")

# OLS Regression: receipts = intercept + slope * year
n = len(years)
sum_x = sum(years)
sum_y = sum(receipts_billions)
sum_xy = sum(x * y for x, y in zip(years, receipts_billions))
sum_x2 = sum(x**2 for x in years)

print(f"\nIntermediate values:")
print(f"n = {n}")
print(f"sum_x = {sum_x}")
print(f"sum_y = {sum_y:.6f}")
print(f"sum_xy = {sum_xy:.6f}")
print(f"sum_x2 = {sum_x2}")

# Calculate slope and intercept using OLS formulas
slope = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_x2 - sum_x**2)
intercept = (sum_y - slope * sum_x) / n

print(f"\nResults:")
print(f"Slope: {slope}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept}")
print(f"\nRounded to 3 decimal places:")
print(f"Slope: {round(slope, 3)}")
print(f"Intercept: {round(intercept, 3)}")

# Verify by calculating R-squared
y_mean = sum_y / n
ss_tot = sum((y - y_mean)**2 for y in receipts_billions)
y_pred = [intercept + slope * x for x in years]
ss_res = sum((y - y_pred)**2 for y, y_pred in zip(receipts_billions, y_pred))
r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
print(f"\nR-squared: {r_squared:.4f}")
print(f"\nFitted line: receipts = {intercept:.3f} + {slope:.3f} * year")
